body: Linters are widely used in code maintenance and real-time IDE editing to surface lint alerts related to performance, style, error-prone, and other patterns in source files. However, existing code benchmarks do not explicitly evaluate linter-guided file refactoring, where models must reduce lint alerts in source files with correct initial functionality while satisfying functionality preservation. We introduce LintEval, a multilingual benchmark for linter-guided file refactoring across C++, Python, and Java, comprising 13,061 programs with correct initial functionality and 171,662 lint alerts extracted using language-specific linters. LintEval jointly evaluates functionality preservation, lint alert reduction, new alert avoidance, and edit minimality. Experiments reveal a persistent trade-off: closed-source commercial models reach up to 90.4% Reduction@P but achieve only 67.1%-68.3% Pass@1, while several open-source small models show low or negative Reduction@P. A controlled fine-tuning study further shows that supervision format matters: refactoring-oriented SFT raises Qwen2.5-Coder-7B Reduction@P from 24.7% to 76.0%. LintEval enables controlled evaluation of models that improve source files under functionality preservation.
summaryZh: LintEval是一个专门用于评估大模型在Linter引导下进行文件重构能力的基准测试。该基准涵盖C++、Python和Java三种语言，包含超过1.3万个程序和17万个Lint告警。研究发现，当前模型在减少Lint告警的同时，往往难以完美保持原有功能，且闭源模型与开源模型在重构策略上存在显著差异。该基准为提升代码生成模型的工程化落地能力提供了重要的评估工具。

glossary.explanationZh: 代码静态分析工具，用于检查代码中的风格、性能和潜在错误。
文件重构，指在不改变外部行为的前提下优化代码结构的过程。
功能保持，指重构过程中确保代码原有逻辑和输出结果不变。
Lint告警减少率指标，衡量模型修复代码规范问题的能力。
